rationale: Despite strong bearish momentum following earnings (price at 1.9% of its daily range, below both VWAP and the 5m 9-EMA on 3.82x relative volume), the current bid-ask spread of $0.33 (28.8 bps) consumes over 42% of the 5-minute ATR ($0.78). Shorting directly at session lows ($114.28) after an $11.99 intraday drop carries poor reward-to-risk and high slippage cost, while no structural higher-low or reclaim of the 9-EMA ($115.36) exists to justify a long reversal.
